title: Polynomial-size circuits for sublanguages of all ones
statement: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean words such that every word in $L$ consists entirely of true bits. Then $L$ is recognized by a family of layered circuits using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates, with size bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
hypotheses_covered: Every word in $L$ belongs to the language of all-true Boolean words.
